summary: Synchrony Card Funding, LLC, as depositor/registrant, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing the designation of additional credit card accounts ($508.2M in principal receivables) into the Synchrony Card Issuance Trust per the existing transfer agreement (dated May 1, 2018, Section 2.6). This is a routine, trust-level operational update—not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or strategic corporate event. The filing merely supplements the asset pool under a pre-existing ABS structure. No board action, advisor, premium, or transaction negotiation involved. Equivalent to a standard securitization replenishment notice. Nothing to watch; no risk-arb angle.
